# Termrise

> Find rising English search terms, check demand with real data and test product ideas. For indie developers.

Termrise collects rising terms from Google Trends and Hacker News, or from CSV files you import, and checks them against search volume, CPC, keyword difficulty and the top 10 search results. It groups the evidence into product opportunities, keeps AI inferences apart from facts, and exports a Markdown product brief. Termrise is in early access and free while in early access. It does not guarantee rankings or revenue.
